2609.31293.title: Why Alzheimer's Speech Screening Fails to Generalize: Bridging the Deployment Gap via Cross-Corpus Evidence Anchoring
2609.31293.paper_summary: Speech-based screening is a promising, non-invasive approach for detecting Alzheimer's disease and related cognitive risks. However, models trained on a single domain often generalize poorly to unseen languages, tasks, or recording protocols. This paper investigates this deployment gap using a leave-one-corpus-out evaluation across four distinct datasets. Among 70 interpretable speech and language features, 59 exhibit direction conflicts between healthy control and cognitive risk groups across corpora, with pause, silence, and speech rate showing high protocol sensitivity. Furthermore, while the XLM-R text baseline achieves strong average performance, its Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) drops to 0.520 on the weakest held-out domain. A standard GroupDRO baseline reaches a 0.766 mean speaker AUC and a 0.504 worst-domain AUC under the same protocol. To address this, we propose a fusion method that integrates XLM-R text baseline scores with evidence anchors selected during training. Balanced fusion achieves a 0.785 mean speaker AUC, while anchor-heavy fusion raises the worst-case speaker AUC to 0.615. This work highlights the need to audit feature transferability and report worst-case domain robustness in cognitive speech screening.
2609.31293.paper_summary_zh: 語音篩檢是一種有前景的非侵入性方法，用於檢測阿茲海默症及相關的認知風險。<lb/>然而，基於單一領域訓練的模型在未見過的語言、任務或錄音協議上通常表現不佳。<lb/>本文通過在四個不同數據集上進行的留一語料庫評估來研究這一部署差距。<lb/>在70個可解釋的語音和語言特徵中，59個在健康對照組和認知風險組之間顯示出方向衝突，停頓、靜默和語速顯示出高協議敏感性。<lb/>此外，雖然XLM-R文本基線達到了強勁的平均表現，但其ROC曲線下面積（AUC）在最弱的保留領域下降至0.520。<lb/>在相同的協議下，標準的GroupDRO基線達到了0.766的平均說話者AUC和0.504的最差領域AUC。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一種融合方法，將XLM-R文本基線分數與訓練期間選擇的證據錨點整合。<lb/>平衡融合達到了0.785的平均說話者AUC，而以錨點為重的融合將最壞情況下的說話者AUC提高到0.615。<lb/>這項工作突顯了審核特徵可轉移性和報告認知語音篩檢中最壞情況領域穩健性的必要性。
